summary: Linda Meigs was a first-time legislative candidate for Alabama House District 20 in the 2018 election. She recorded approximately +15.1 out-of-fold CMO, with a resource-adjusted score of about +9.7. Her campaign priorities included Medicaid expansion and an education lottery; she linked Medicaid expansion to hospital closures, infant mortality, mental-health services, addiction treatment, and diabetes care. This platform is coded as mildly progressive economic policy relative to contemporary Alabama Democrats but does not support broader left-right identity inference. Meigs was a retired Grissom High School teacher who participated in local Democratic organizations.
